Deus, qui Ecclésiam tuam beáti Gregórii: 天主，祢曾藉着祢的精修圣人主教圣额我略以宗教热忱与宗徒的辛劳扩展了祢的教会：求祢因其功绩与转祷恩赐，使她常能领受信德与圣洁的新进益。
_notes: 1. Source has 'Contessóris' which is a typo for 'Confessóris'; key preserved verbatim as instructed. 2. 'Gregórii … Pontíficis': 'Pontifex' here rendered 主教 per glossary §9 pattern 'Confessor Pontifex = 精修圣人主教'; if this refers to Gregory the Great (a Pope), 教宗 would also be defensible, but the explicit glossary lock takes precedence. 3. 'apostólicis curis' = 宗徒的辛劳 (apostolic labours/cares). 4. No scripture quotation; no 思高 fetch required.
